title: Apple Crumble & Custard by Dripping Desserts E Liquid | 100ml Short Fill
description:
Apple Crumble & Custard Shortfill E-Liquid:
Apple Crumble & Custard is a decadent dessert-inspired blend that perfectly captures the taste of a freshly baked classic. Indulge in the warm, gooey sweetness of spiced apples layered with a buttery crumble topping, all finished with a smooth and creamy custard infused with hints of vanilla. This flavour is rich, comforting, and beautifully balanced, offering a delightful harmony of fruitiness and dessert decadence that’s as satisfying as the real thing.
Product Features:
Brand:
Dripping Desserts
Brand Origin:
UK
Product Type:
Shortfill E-Liquid.
Bottle Size:
Supplied in a 120ml bottle containing 100ml of flavoured E-Liquid, leaving space for Nicotine shots if required, e.g., add 2 x 18mg Nicotine shots (not included) to 100ml to make a 3mg final strength.
Nicotine Type:
Nicotine Free.
Nicotine Strength:
This E-Liquid is 0mg (before any Nicotine shots have been added –
Juice Mix:
With a 70% VG / 30% PG mix, this E-Liquid is perfect for the Direct Inhale style of vaping using Sub Ohm Coils. Not recommended for MTL vaping.
